title: Join Our Email List
closedMessage: Email-list requests are closed. For help joining or leaving, email hello@badgersupports.org.
intro: At Badger Supports, we create peer to peer spaces to talk about mental health, connect with others, and feel less alone. Whether you're in a group, workshop, or craft night, you're part of a community that gets it.
Join our email list to stay up-to-date on our latest updates, events, and more!
review: Built closed (decision 3.1), from Google's public view of 23 Oct 2026; the Email List page still links the Google Form. Words are Google's, with these changes. Google's form is one page. 'Your Email' is our section title; 'Add Yourself (Optional)' is Google's 'Add Yourself (OPTIONAL)' in the page's Title Case. Google's four numbered steps stay numbered; its first, 'CLICK HERE to send an email to …', reads as the Email List page's does ('Send an email to …'), with the address as a link below the steps, and Google's bold and asterisks on 'Do not use the option…' are dropped. 'All set! Click submit!' is dropped: the button says Send. The confirmation is ours. It says the request is received and the person is not on the list yet, because the site knows only that: whether they are invited, pending or subscribed is known to the Google Group, and to Connect once someone records it (WORK.md item 12). How a request reaches the group today is the owner's step 7. No receipt: the site never emails an address no one has confirmed. Current local refinement: the manual membership workflow is established by the owner response in PUBLIC-EMAIL-LIST-STATES. No cadence/delivery-time guarantee or membership-status inference; existing source instructions retained where useful. The source remains closed and its existing Google fallback is explicit.

questions.label: Email
questions.help: Use an email address you plan to keep, including a personal email address.
questions.review: Google's is a short-answer box marked Email; this one checks the address is an email address. The help is Google's.

list: Look for a confirmation email from Google Groups.
To complete your subscription to the email list, reply to the email you received and send a blank email. Do not use the option of clicking the ‘Join This Group’ button.
For help joining or leaving the list, email hello@badgersupports.org.

confirmation.title: Request Received
body: Thank you. We have your request to join the Badger Supports email list.
A person who manages the Google Group handles membership. This request confirmation does not show whether you are subscribed.
For help joining or leaving the list, email hello@badgersupports.org.

source.read: Public respondent view, 23 Oct 2026, read for its questions only. Settings, destination sheet, scripts and responses not opened. Google's form name begins EXEC, so the owner is Executive; Connect keeps only the leaders' newsletter list today, so the queue is a proposal.
